idea: a sleepy cloud who collects raindrops to water a desert garden
creator: Ahmed
title: Puff's Desert Garden

design.title: Puff's Desert Garden
design.tagline: Drift, drip and doze your way to blooming a sleepy desert oasis.
design.story: Puff, a tiny sleepy cloud, drifted over a thirsty desert. The gardens below dreamed of rain. Half-asleep, Puff set off to gather lost raindrops and drizzle them into sprouts, waking flowers and nudging grumpy dust critters aside, to grow a cozy oasis garden.

hero.name: Puff
hero.look: A small round dozy cumulus puff with cotton-soft white to pale-blue fluff, droopy eyes and rosy cheeks.

world.setting: A soft pastel desert at dawn with rolling dunes, floating sandstone ledges, tiny oases and sprouting gardens under a vast sleepy sky.

specialMechanic.name: Drizzle Bloom
specialMechanic.howItWorks: Collect raindrops, then drift over thirsty sprouts and press down to drizzle. Watered sprouts bloom into bouncy flowers you can bounce on to reach high places.

levels.name: Drowsy Dunes
levels.idea: Learn to run, jump and softly bonk dust mites while gathering raindrops to bloom your first bounce flowers to the garden arch.

levels.name: Moonlit Oasis Bloom
levels.idea: A twilight garden with wider gaps and fluttery moths. Chain drizzle blooms and soft bounces to cross the oasis and finish the garden.

verdict.summary: Puff runs, jumps, collects drops, blooms sprouts, stomps enemies and takes a hit in a lively desert garden.
verdict.seen: Screenshots show a bright desert dune world with mesas, blue wavy platforms, a white cloud hero, blue drop enemies, sprouts and bloomed flowers, with a readable score and hearts HUD.

patches.diagnosis: The level list contained a broken entry that crashed the game while building level 1, so nothing could load or play. Removing that stray entry lets the levels build normally.

seasons.notes: Built Puff's Desert Garden with raindrop collectibles and custom drizzle-bloom sprouts that turn into bouncy flowers, two 80x12 dune levels, and a hint HUD.
